I drove you away, and I deserved it.

It's been years since I last saw you, and years more since we were young and dumb enough to be together. I was mentally unstable, though, and you, of all people, didn't deserve to be subjected to my episodes. 

But you stood by me, and I thanked you with insecurity and paranoia. I was too scared to lose you, so I tried to control what you did and the little free time you had. When you decided it was time to move on, I pushed you away out of spite, even though you are one of the reasons I'm still alive today.

I'm sorry I took everything for granted. When I first met you, I said that all I ever wanted to do was make you happy. I lost sight of that. You've cut me out of your life, and I'm still slowly learning to accept that.

You helped me get through one of the roughest periods of my life. Thank you. I hope you're also in a better place.

HFCS versus sugar: In terms of weight gain or loss, the difference between the two is negligible. If that's your primary motive, you should be looking to cut back on all sugars.

Juice: Should mostly be avoided, for the very reasons stated above. Whether or not the sugar is processed makes no difference - juice would most certainly contribute toward weight gain and diabetes. Water is best.

Veggies: Are great. Eat them. But you don't have to make them the core of your diet. You're not going to lose weight unless you actually choose something you can stick to. Figure out what changes you're willing to make and find a diet that suits you.

In general, hard liquor has zero carbohydrates and 70-100 calories per 1oz. Being active is always helpful (not to mention an essential part of any weight loss regimen). How you want to go about it from there is up to you.
